docs.text: CivicNet Network The CivicNet (CIVIC) network is a hybrid Proof-of-Work + Proof-of-Stake blockchain. This system entity groups the full-node components and related infrastructure in the Backstage catalog. Consensus Hybrid PoW + PoS 60-second target block time PoS ceiling of 30% — at most 30% of blocks can come from staking PoS win condition: hash(kernel) < target * sqrt(UTXO) Anti-cluster N=2 PoW to prevent a single miner dominating consecutive blocks Components in this system Component Type Notes CivicNet full node service Vendored source + patched, Docker + systemd deploy Key facts RPC port 9332 P2P port 9333 Consensus PoW + PoS Staking Optional (30% ceiling) Operating documentation See the individual node component TechDocs pages for full runbooks — deployment, configuration, API, and troubleshooting. This system page is the catalog-level overview.
